description: This file contains a mock implementation of the SSPI library for Windows, including classes and functions to simulate credential and security context handling for testing purposes.

classes.name: MockCredential
classes.description: Represents a mock credential with source principal, package, and handle storage.

classes.name: MockContext
classes.description: Represents a mock security context with associated credential, target principal, and handle storage.

methods.name: StoreInHandle
methods.description: Stores the credential or context object into the provided handle, ensuring uniqueness.

methods.name: FromHandle
methods.description: Retrieves the credential or context object from a handle.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the mock context.

methods.name: MockSSPILibrary
methods.description: Constructor initializing the mock SSPI library with a package name.

methods.name: ~MockSSPILibrary
methods.description: Destructor verifying cleanup of internal states.

methods.name: AcquireCredentialsHandle
methods.description: Mocks acquiring a credentials handle, assigning a new credential object.

methods.name: InitializeSecurityContext
methods.description: Mocks initializing a security context, creating and rotating contexts.

methods.name: QueryContextAttributesEx
methods.description: Mocks querying context attributes like native names, negotiation info, and authority.

methods.name: QuerySecurityPackageInfo
methods.description: Mocks retrieving security package info, with support for expected responses.

methods.name: ExpectQuerySecurityPackageInfo
methods.description: Sets up expected responses for package info queries.
